scope: Shared-protocol question planning for three large provisional-ID agentic inventories. Original inspection limits remain; these cards are not reviewed individual biological cases or validated coverage.

defaults.data: Independent observed inputs and native data formats; preserve real biological replication and lineage. No source benchmark fixtures, expected labels or answer text used for task authoring.
defaults.consolidation: Do not instantiate one task per registry row. Split on distinct measured properties, variant classes, leakage risks or evidence requirements, then merge compatible questions across benchmarks.
defaults.authoring_status: Planning only. No implementation workers assigned.

questions.scientific_question: Which protein attributes in an independent graph agree with the pinned source records, and which remain contradicted or unresolved?
required_endpoint_stages: resolve protein identifier, species and source version
query the graph node and requested attribute
retrieve the corresponding database record and distinguish missing fields from missing entries
reconcile naming and identifier changes and preserve the evidence
observed_input_requirements: Pinned public gene/protein/variant/database exports with accession versions, species, directed relations, dates and evidence identifiers.
required_formats: UniProt flatfile or equivalent pinned record
proposed_artifact_requirements: Identity map, provenance manifest, directed edge/evidence tables, contradictions, structured answer and supporting accession/span references
deterministic_verification_approach: Deterministic joins, direction/type checks and evidence-span linkage; unknown is allowed; a text citation match does not establish full scientific entailment.
questions.evaluation_contract: Return complete identity/evidence tables with source, version, relation direction, context and a support/contradiction/unresolved disposition under a frozen rule. Verify joins and structured rules mechanically. Lack of an edge or retrieved document is not evidence of biological absence; inspect negative-evidence and closed-world assumptions separately.
questions.source_protocol_limits: A deterministic query over frozen structured records covers acquisition/reconciliation and rule-based evidence only. It does not establish full equivalence to unconstrained literature synthesis, patient diagnosis or delivery-method selection. Individual evidence and faithful acceptance criteria remain unreviewed; no full-coverage gain is predicted.

questions.scientific_question: Which directed biological graph edges are supported by independent structured experimental evidence rather than co-mention or undirected association?
required_endpoint_stages: resolve both typed entities and the exact relation semantics
query directed relations, node presence and source provenance
retrieve supporting or contradicting source records and literature when required
distinguish physical interaction, association, localization and inferred annotation
export relation, evidence identifiers and a scoped conclusion
